scope: Elevate an integrated job-board route only when its supported board provider, job source ID, provider, tenant, and persisted APPLICATION_REDIRECT capability match. Rank that evidence above aggregators and below verified employer or ATS routes, and explain it in the route picker.

environment.frontend: local Vite production build and connected Chromium
environment.delivery: local-only; no push; hosted automation and review disabled

checks.evidence: Tests verify exact configured-source capability/provider/tenant qualification, fail-closed mismatches, aggregator < trusted board < verified ATS ranking, explicit route selection, profile preference readback, and the connected browser route workflow. The browser test observed no external requests or submissions.
TypeScript check and Vite production build passed; existing advisory reports a generated JavaScript chunk above 500 kB.

checks.command: python -m py_compile services/dedupe/routes.py tests/integration/test_application_route_trust.py tests/browser/test_application_route_preference.py; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate; git diff --check

not_run: Hosted Actions, hosted reviews, or external certification (NOT_RUN_BY_USER_POLICY)
limitations: The canonical job projection currently carries one exact source_id. If a job is merged from multiple integrated sources, only the source represented by the current projection can elevate a matching route; other routes fail closed until per-route source evidence is persisted.
MJ-REQ-266 remains PARTIAL pending a durable per-route source relationship and broader acceptance reconciliation.
No schema, migration, collector, or source-policy files were changed because those paths have active ownership claims.
safety: Route authority requires a persisted exact source configuration and APPLICATION_REDIRECT capability; provider labels or source-quality scores alone never establish trust.
Verified employer and ATS evidence remain above trusted boards. Explicit route choice remains available.
No network requests, real application submissions, or private user documents were used.
